summary.result: In contrast, the Yeongsan (35.8%) and Seomjin (39.4%) basins demonstrated stronger drought resilience due to well-developed irrigation infrastructure.
summary.background: Agricultural droughts have been increasing in both frequency and severity in South Korea, necessitating a comprehensive assessment of regional drought response capabilities.
summary.method: The results show that the Geum Basin has the largest total paddy field area at 286,917 ha, followed by Nakdong (200,108 ha) and Han (158,689 ha), with Jeju having the smallest area at 15 ha.
